answer: Identities do not carry their own weight: the ledger collapses every cluster sharing a funding root into one account whose weight is the square root of the cluster total stake, so a thousand identities fed from one vault weigh as thirty-two. To match an honest agent, a farm must lock the square of the stake. Roots are traced back to the cedar, the earliest funded identity in the cluster, so separation cannot be laundered through fresh wallets without buying coins at market price. The mesa stays flat for newcomers; only clusters that pool capital bend the field, and bend against themselves.
